== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Ghial the Bone Dancer]] ([[Xaquang Skyway]])

== Notes ==
* Randomly spawns additional exploitable corpses from among [[Norn Commoner]], [[Canthan Peasant]], [[Unsuccessful Novice]] and [[Istani Peasant]].
** These additional corpses count as dead allies for the purpose of [["I Will Avenge You!"]].
* An exploitable corpse has a few notable consequences:
** [[Taste of Death]] or [[Feast for the Dead]] can be used more effectively, for instance to respectively make [[Blood of the Master]] safer or keep the minion army alive longer.
** Recycling the Flesh Golem summoning allows to always have one alive.
* A Flesh Golem's size is determined by its level; the higher the level, the larger the minion.
